responsibility: Defines the generated immutable and mutable MIR visitor framework, including exhaustive default traversal over MIR structure, contextual classifications for place and type visits, and the `MirVisitable` hook used to apply visitors at statement and terminator locations.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `thir/visit.rs`, which walks THIR trees, and `ty/visit.rs`, which provides helpers atop the generic type visitor for regions and universes, this file defines the generated visitor framework specialized to MIR bodies, statements, terminators, places, and their contextual use classifications.
